notes:
The phone and tablet player includes Google Cast for compatible direct HTTPS M3U-provider streams. Open Cast, choose a trusted Chromecast or Google TV on the same Wi-Fi, then choose Play on TV. The phone pauses once the receiver reports playback. Android screen casting is available separately when supported by the device. Account URLs, custom headers, query tokens, local recordings and timeshift stay on the phone. Receiver format, codec, network and CORS support still apply.

Home followed events and the Sports no-live schedule show page dots. Missing-art poster titles are centered. Posters no longer carry the Suggested label, banners say Featured, and the stream picker preserves the full landscape artwork.

Validated with Android phone and TV emulators and synthetic listings. Playback on a physical Cast receiver has not been verified. AirPlay and phone-to-TV pairing are deferred.
